messages:
Maya: Night mood check 9: thinking about pairing short sci-fi films with albums for a late-night watch. Prefer under 90 mins. Neon, a little wistful. Any combos?
Oliver: 'Coherence' is a solid pick. Pair it with Boards of Canada (Music Has the Right to Children) for that analog, slightly eerie vibe. :headphones:
Devon: 'Prospect' is tight and atmospheric. For score, try Cliff Martinez (Drive) or John Carpenters synth stuff.
Samir: 'ARQ' (Netflix) is compact time-loop goodness. Pair with Trent Reznor & Atticus Ross for industrial tension. Makes late-night coding feel cinematic.
Jen: For something tiny and surreal, 'World of Tomorrow' (short) + Tycho album for a soft, melancholy contrast. Works surprisingly well. :sparkles:
Maya: Love Tycho rec. Anyone have playlists? Spotify links helpful.
Oliver: Heres my late-night playlist: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/3example  synthwave + ambient mix. Use it as a template.
Devon: Two-question poll: upbeat synthwave (The Midnight) or ambient textures (Tim Hecker) for watching?
Samir: Ambient textures. Upbeat pulls my attention away. :raised_hand: 
Jen: Split here. Upbeat while cooking, ambient while watching/reading. :popcorn:
Maya: musicbot: add "Coherence + Boards of Canada" to #watchlist, please
musicbot: Added to watchlist: "Coherence  Boards of Canada" (requested by Maya). Use `/watchlist` to view or `@musicbot recommend` for more. :robot_face:
Oliver: Wild card: 'Enter the Void' if you want an intense neon dream. Pair with Oneohtrix Point Never but beware its a sleepless-night movie. :grimacing:
Maya: Amazing suggestions. If anyone finds short neo-noir sci-fi shorts, ping me. Coffee is on me next time. :coffee:
